messages:
user-marcus: Hey team — running into a weird SchemaValidationError when calling the tool API from a PowerShell script. Same JSON payload works from curl on macOS.

user-marcus: Minimal repro attached below (pwsh):
```powershell
$payload = '{"tool":"invoice","args":{"invoice_id":"INV-123\u200B45","amount":100}}'
$payload = $payload | Out-String
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/tool/run\" -Method Post -Body $payload -ContentType \"application/json\" -Headers @{Authorization=\"Bearer $KEY\"}
```

user-marcus: Server returns 400 with body: `{"error":"SchemaValidationError","message":"invoice_id: invalid format"}`. If I copy the payload into curl it works. :confused:

support-jen: Thanks — can you paste the exact raw request body from pwsh (use `Write-Host $payload | Format-Hex` or similar)? Also which PowerShell version / Windows?

user-marcus: Windows PowerShell 7.3.4. Here's the Format-Hex output for the invoice_id portion (I highlighted the sequence):
```
00000000  49 4E 56 2D 31 32 33 E2 80 8B 34 35
           I  N  V  -  1  2  3  .. .. ..  4  5
```

user-marcus: The `E2 80 8B` bytes correspond to U+200B (zero-width space). I didn't intentionally put it there — it was a paste from a doc.

eng-alex: This matches what I've seen: copying from some editors (Word, certain web UIs) can insert U+200B. The JSON string then fails our schema because `invoice_id` doesn't match the expected regex. Quick client-side workaround: strip the char before sending. In pwsh: `
$payload = $payload.Replace([char]0x200B, '')
Invoke-RestMethod ...
`

eng-alex: Server-side mitigation we can do quickly: middleware to sanitize incoming JSON strings (strip common invisible/control unicode like U+200B, U+FEFF) before schema validation. I'll open ENG-4312 and push a draft patch for staging.

sre-luca: Please also add a telemetry grep to identify other requests with 0xE2 0x80 0x8B in body so we can measure scope. Suggested query for logs: `body:/\u200B/ OR body:(%E2%80%8B)` and a Kibana dashboard.

support-jen: Escalating to ENG-4312, assigned to eng-alex. Temporary support note: if customers report `SchemaValidationError` for simple string fields, ask them to check for hidden unicode (zero-width) and try `.Replace([char]0x200B,'')` in PowerShell or `payload = payload.replace(/\u200B/g,'')` in JS. Adding an internal KB entry. :memo:

deploy-bot: rollout/ENG-4312 scheduled to staging (canary) — 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC :rocket:

support-jen: Thanks @eng-alex and @sre-luca. Marcus — can you confirm the workaround cleared your issue?

user-marcus: Confirmed — `.Replace([char]0x200B,'')` fixed it. Customers on our side who pasted IDs from Word were affected. Appreciate the quick triage. :+1:
